column1: # Harness revisions that committed rows cite but that were never pushed:
# each was a local commit rebuilt with a new committer date on push. The
# rows stay as written; scripts/paper_audit.py reads a cited revision that
# is not in the repository as its pushed_revision when every check here
# holds. pushed_revision is on develop and branch_revision is the same
# commit on the branch that was pushed first; both have patch_id
# (git patch-id --stable). rows_commit is the develop commit that first
# wrote rows citing local_revision; its parent is pushed_revision
